items.exampleEn: This painting shows a snowy landscape.
items.exampleZh: 這幅畫畫的是一片雪景。

items.exampleEn: Birds carry seeds to new places.
items.exampleZh: 鳥會把種子帶到新的地方。

items.exampleEn: Can we swim in this lake?
items.exampleZh: 我們可以在這個湖裡游泳嗎？

items.exampleEn: The Sahara is a very large desert.
items.exampleZh: 撒哈拉是一片非常大的沙漠。

items.exampleEn: This movie is about a creature from space.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影在講一隻來自太空的生物。

items.exampleEn: We live on the coast, so we often eat fish.
items.exampleZh: 我們住在海岸邊，所以常吃魚。

items.exampleEn: This egg has a brown shell.
Our village is in a valley.

items.sentenceEn: The lake is very quiet in the morning.

items.audioEn: We drove along the coast and stopped at a small beach.
items.audioZh: 我們沿著海岸開車，在一個小海灘停了下來。

items.sentenceEn: We grow our own vegetables from seeds.
items.sentenceZh: 我們自己用種子種蔬菜。

items.sentenceEn: Many small creatures live in this river.
items.sentenceZh: 很多小生物住在這條河裡。

items.stemEn: A river runs through the green ____ between the hills.
items.stemZh: 一條河流過山丘之間那片綠色的山谷。

items.stemEn: It is very hot and dry in the ____.
items.stemZh: 沙漠裡非常炎熱又乾燥。

items.passageEn: Last month, my uncle, a photographer, took me on a trip. First, we visited a desert, where the landscape was brown and gold. Then we drove to the coast. I found a pretty shell on the beach, and my uncle took photos of small sea creatures. On the last day, we camped by a lake in a quiet valley. A farmer there gave me some flower seeds for my garden.
items.passageZh: 上個月，當攝影師的叔叔帶我去旅行。我們先去了沙漠，那裡的景色一片褐色和金色。接著我們開車到海岸。我在海灘上撿到一個漂亮的貝殼，叔叔則拍了一些小小的海洋生物。最後一天，我們在一個安靜山谷裡的湖邊露營。那裡的一位農夫送我一些花的種子，讓我帶回去種在花園裡。

questions.questionZh: 作者在海灘上找到什麼？
最後一天他們在哪裡露營？

items.promptZh: 我在海灘上撿了很多貝殼。
referenceEn: I picked up many shells on the beach.
I found a lot of shells on the beach.
rubricZh: 「貝殼」用 shell，這裡用複數 shells

items.instructionZh: 用 landscape 造一個句子，描述你看過的一處風景。
referenceEn: The landscape in Hualien is beautiful.
I love the green landscape of the countryside.
rubricZh: landscape 表示「（大片的）風景、地景」（例如 the landscape of the countryside）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 The landscape is）
